questions.question: Describe three Frantic Assembly techniques and explain the dramatic effect each can create.

points.text: Three named techniques with dramatic effect: chair work (rhythm, aggression, status); push hands (tension, balance of power); lift and lean (trust, dependency, vulnerability). Each linked to specific dramatic meaning.

questions.question: How can physical theatre communicate emotions and relationships more effectively than dialogue alone?

points.text: Physical theatre bypasses language to communicate directly through the body — proximity, touch, weight and rhythm reveal relationship dynamics instantly. It can show conflict, intimacy or power shifts without a single word.

questions.question: You are creating a devised piece about conflict. How would you use physical theatre techniques to explore this theme?

points.text: Practical response showing: push hands to show conflict escalation; unison breaking into counterpoint to show unity fracturing; chair work to create aggressive confrontations; lift/lean to show shifting power. Each linked to the theme of conflict.
